sources: Published BEAM05 layered L cutoff and symmetric T lap inputs, with three-moment statics and independent section equilibrium and link takeoff.

method.scope: One separated Ø20 outer-bottom lap in span 1 of the prismatic right-flanged L web cage. Use two aligned inner bars, uniform closed web links and supplied vertical-plane ULS rows with zero torsion. Keep B2-3 omitted as in the symmetric T control. The result covers the declared in-plane actions, web reinforcement and bent links.
method.actions: Check the U1/U2 signed moment and shear pairs from 24/32 kN/m on equal 4 m spans with uniform stiffness and simple outer supports. Loads and reactions define a vertical-plane benchmark with no supplied torque or transverse action. Keep support-centre rows diagnostic.
method.section: Use the L expression bw + l0/12 + 3 Df, capped by the physical one-sided tributary width, for sagging compression. Monolithic flange participation and vertical-plane response are prescribed by the benchmark. Check that the neutral axis lies in the flange. Use the web for hogging compression and signed shear. Flange reinforcement, lateral flexure and torsion transfer require separate evidence.
method.lap_window: Screen the entire positive-moment interval using its analytical extrema and the declared half-sagging-resistance limit. Verify M/V from both single-partner transfer layouts. Check straight development, spliced fraction, cover, clearances and link pitch. Count and draw both physical partners inside the overlap.
method.support: Check straight development in the physical support direction using each support-face row. For positive anchorage, compare the three-times-projection limit with the web-only flexural resistance divided by the concurrent shear plus extension beyond the support centre.
method.outputs: The checked report identifies the L profile, effective flange, lap transfer rows and governing acceptance and anchorage checks. The elevation, three physical sections and BBS use the same checked paths and current revisions. FAIL and HOLD specify diagnostic report availability and withhold the checked drawing and BBS.
